versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "licia" skill version 1.0.0.
- Provides advice on using the licia utility library for JavaScript/TypeScript projects.
- Activates when simplifying code, refactoring with utilities, or replacing hand-written utility functions.
- Supports a wide range of code areas: type checking, string/array/object manipulation, DOM operations, data structures, encoding, date formatting, and more.
- Includes import examples, usage guidelines, and a categorized reference of available utilities.
